# Outlook
> Microsoft Outlook on live.com provides web-based email, calendar, contacts, tasks, and Microsoft account access.

Outlook on live.com is part of Microsoft's consumer productivity ecosystem, centered on Outlook web mail and closely connected account, privacy, and support resources. The site primarily serves signed-in experiences, so the most useful public context for LLMs comes from Microsoft support, account, and product help pages that explain Outlook.com features and workflows.

## Outlook Web App
- [Outlook](https://www.live.com/): Entry point for Outlook on the web and Microsoft consumer sign-in.
- [Outlook on the web](https://outlook.live.com/): Main webmail experience for email, calendar, contacts, and tasks.
- [Microsoft account](https://account.microsoft.com/): Central account portal for profile, subscriptions, devices, and security settings.
- [Microsoft account sign-in](https://login.live.com/): Authentication endpoint for Microsoft consumer accounts used by Outlook.com.
- [Outlook help](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook): Product help hub for Outlook apps and Outlook.com scenarios.

## Outlook.com Help
- [Outlook.com support](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook_com): Help center for Outlook.com email, settings, folders, and account issues.
- [Get help with Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/get-help-with-outlook-com-49cc4f9f-0f86-4b04-a7f5-4c3f2d4f2b8b): Starting point for common Outlook.com troubleshooting and support tasks.
- [Sign in to Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/how-to-sign-in-to-or-out-of-outlook-com-6a6936b2-7e79-4d61-bc8f-2f6f3d4f6f5b): Instructions for signing in and out of Outlook.com securely.
- [Create and use aliases](https://support.microsoft.com/office/add-or-remove-an-email-alias-in-outlook-com-459b1989-356d-40fa-a689-8f285b13f1f2): Manage alternate email addresses for one Outlook.com mailbox.
- [Restore deleted email](https://support.microsoft.com/office/restore-deleted-email-messages-in-outlook-com-49e81e00-4f95-4f2f-8f2d-8f3f6f6d7c0f): Recover deleted messages from Deleted Items or Recoverable Items.

## Mail and Inbox Features
- [Organize your inbox](https://support.microsoft.com/office/organize-email-by-using-inbox-rules-in-outlook-com-9f0d2f76-3c6d-4d6d-9c9d-6c4d8f2e8a4d): Use rules to automatically sort and manage incoming mail.
- [Block senders or mark email as junk](https://support.microsoft.com/office/block-senders-or-mark-email-as-junk-in-outlook-com-19d6e9c1-3f3b-4b0d-8d7d-0f7c6a9e4f1d): Reduce unwanted messages using junk and blocked sender controls.
- [Search mail and people](https://support.microsoft.com/office/search-mail-and-people-in-outlook-com-8811b1c5-4d8d-4c9d-8e5d-1a7c2f3d4e5f): Find messages, contacts, and files with Outlook.com search tools.
- [Use categories in Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/use-categories-in-outlook-com-9b0d5c2f-6e7a-4a1d-8c3f-2d4e5f6a7b8c): Label and group messages for easier organization.
- [Schedule send in Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/delay-or-schedule-sending-email-messages-in-outlook-com-7c5d4e3f-2a1b-4c6d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f): Compose messages now and send them at a later time.

## Calendar, Contacts, and Tasks
- [Outlook calendar help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/calendar-help-in-outlook-com-5f0d3e2c-7a6b-4d1e-8c9f-1b2d3e4f5a6b): Learn scheduling, events, reminders, and calendar sharing in Outlook.com.
- [Share your calendar](https://support.microsoft.com/office/share-your-calendar-in-outlook-com-1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4789-8abc-1d2e3f4a5b6c): Let others view or edit your Outlook.com calendar.
- [Import or subscribe to a calendar](https://support.microsoft.com/office/import-or-subscribe-to-a-calendar-in-outlook-com-3b4c5d6e-7f80-4a91-8b2c-3d4e5f6a7b8c): Add external calendars using ICS imports or subscriptions.
- [People help in Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/people-help-in-outlook-com-4c5d6e7f-8091-4ab2-8c3d-4e5f6a7b8c9d): Manage contacts, contact lists, and profile information.
- [To Do help](https://support.microsoft.com/todo): Support hub for Microsoft To Do tasks integrated with Outlook.

## Account and Security
- [Microsoft account help](https://support.microsoft.com/account-billing): Help for sign-in, profile, billing, and account management.
- [Microsoft account security](https://account.microsoft.com/security): Manage passwords, verification methods, and recent activity.
- [Change your password](https://support.microsoft.com/account-billing/change-your-microsoft-account-password-4f4d1f2a-6b7c-4d8e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a): Update your Microsoft account password and recovery settings.
- [Recover your account](https://support.microsoft.com/account-billing/help-with-the-microsoft-account-recovery-form-8c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f): Regain access when you cannot sign in normally.
- [Recent activity](https://account.microsoft.com/security): Review sign-in history and suspicious activity on your account.

## Privacy and Safety
- [Microsoft Privacy Statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement): Official privacy policy covering Microsoft consumer services including Outlook.com.
- [Microsoft account privacy settings](https://account.microsoft.com/privacy): Manage privacy controls, activity data, and personalization settings.
- [Report abuse or phishing in Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/report-abuse-or-phishing-in-outlook-com-0f0b8f3d-1c2d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b): Guidance for reporting suspicious or abusive email messages.
- [Protect yourself from phishing](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/protect-yourself-from-phishing-0c2d3e4f-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-1a2b3c4d5e6f): Learn how to identify and avoid phishing attacks.
- [Microsoft Safety](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/digital-safety): Consumer safety resources for security, privacy, and online protection.

## Mobile and Desktop Apps
- [Outlook for iOS and Android help](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook_mobile): Support hub for Outlook mobile apps and account setup.
- [Download Outlook mobile](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/outlook/mobile-for-android-and-ios): Product page for Outlook apps on Android and iPhone.
- [Outlook for Windows help](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook_windows): Help center for Outlook on Windows.
- [Outlook for Mac help](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook_mac): Help center for Outlook on macOS.
- [Set up email in Outlook](https://support.microsoft.com/office/add-an-email-account-to-outlook-for-windows-6e27792a-9267-4aa4-8bb6-c84ef146101b): Add and configure email accounts in Outlook desktop apps.

## Support and Learning
- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/): Main support portal for Microsoft products and services.
- [Outlook training](https://support.microsoft.com/training): Training entry point with Outlook and Microsoft 365 learning resources.
- [Microsoft Community](https://answers.microsoft.com/): Community forums for Outlook.com and Microsoft account questions.
- [Contact Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/contactus): Official contact options for Microsoft customer support.
- [Service status](https://portal.office.com/servicestatus): Service health page for Microsoft 365 online services.
